tagline: This app: one screen showing the state of all my projects
summary: Just built. A VS Code-style activity bar lists the projects as icons. Each project page combines curated analysis (what's implemented, a feature-parity matrix against similar apps, prioritized next steps, risks) with live data: GitHub commits, languages and issues (ETag-cached), and the local clone's branch, uncommitted changes and unpushed commits, found by scanning sibling folders. The GitHub repo is still empty because nothing has been pushed.

items: VS Code-style activity bar with an icon per project and a tooltip with its name
Overview dashboard with a card per project
Project page: summary, KPIs, what's implemented, comparison matrix, next steps, risks and activity
Section outline side panel and a status bar
Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9 switch projects, R refreshes
Curated analysis per project in analysis/<id>.json, with an auto-computed parity score
Live GitHub data with ETag caching, optional token (GITHUB_TOKEN or gh), and a fallback without the token
Local clones found automatically by matching origin remotes in sibling folders
'Analysis may be stale' badge when the repo has commits after analyzedAt
In-progress section for work that isn't on main yet (branches, uncommitted changes)
